title: Father's Last Words
next_chapter_hook: In the instant when the remnant soul scattered, Chen Fu's final words thundered like a bolt from the blue: 'Go see your mother's true face'—that face erased by the Eye of Heavenly Way, what earth-shaking secret does it conceal?

text.content:
The collapse of the Heavenly Realm Core was like a silent cosmic apocalypse. Countless timeline fragments scattered and flew in all directions, each reflecting a different fate trajectory—In some worlds, Chen Ji ascended to immortality; in others, he suffered endless calamities; and in some, he never existed at all.

In this moment of primordial chaos, the Turtle Shell artifact on Chen Ji's chest suddenly grew scalding hot, almost burning him. He lowered his gaze to the cracked Turtle Shell that had accompanied him for years, now frantically absorbing something—not Spiritual Energy, not Heavenly Fate Value, but... the causal forces residual within the timeline fragments.

'Father?' Chen Ji's heart stirred, his fingers unconsciously tracing the shell's cracks.

The Turtle Shell had been silent for far too long. So long that Chen Ji almost believed it was merely his wishful thinking. But now, the collapse of the Heavenly Realm Core provided sufficient energy fuel for this artifact that had slumbered for twenty years.

An aged yet gentle voice rang out from the depths of the Turtle Shell, as if traversing endless rivers of time:

'Ji'er... you've grown up.'

The voice was so feeble it nearly scattered in the wind, yet it carried a tenderness Chen Ji had never heard before. His eyes instantly burned with heat—for the first time in twenty years, this discarded disciple who had never shed a single tear felt an urge to cry.

Twenty years. A full twenty years.

He had believed his father died long ago in that sect encirclement. He had thought he would never hear this voice again. He had assumed he had grown accustomed to relying solely on himself.

But now, as that aged voice rang out once more, he realized the child deep within him who had always yearned for his father's approval had never truly disappeared.

dialogue.content: 'Father...' Chen Ji's voice was hoarse beyond recognition, 'How can you be here? Weren't you already...'

text.content:
A hazy light figure emerged on the surface of the Turtle Shell—the silhouette of a middle-aged man, bearing a sevenfold resemblance to Chen Ji, only more haggard, more weary. His form flickered in and out of existence, as if he might dissipate in the collapsing torrent of time at any moment.

'Silly child, your father's remnant soul has been protecting you within this Turtle Shell all along.' Chen Fu's phantom wore a bitter smile, 'When I exhausted my final strand of divine consciousness to send you away, it was precisely to await this day.'

He raised his illusory hand, pointing toward the scattered fragments of timelines:

'The Heavenly Realm Core has collapsed, and all fetters of destiny are loosening. This is our Chen family's sole opportunity—and our last. Ji'er, you must learn the truth.'

dialogue.content: 'What truth?' Chen Ji suppressed the churning emotions within him, forcing himself to remain calm. He knew his father's time was running out, every second depleting this remnant soul's final reserves of energy.

text.content:
Chen Fu's phantom drifted slowly toward Chen Ji, passing through layers of collapsing timeline fragments, gazing directly into his eyes. That gaze held guilt, tenderness, and an even more resolute determination.

'Our Chen family is not an ordinary cultivator bloodline.' His voice grew low and grave, 'We are... the Awakening Program.'

Chen Ji was stunned.

'Hundreds of thousands of years ago, there existed a being beyond the will of Heavenly Way—let us call it the 'Creator' for now. He created a seed capable of breaking fate, implanting it into the bloodlines of mortal beings, passed down through generations, awaiting the day when someone could awaken and shatter this chess game controlled by the Eye of Heavenly Way.'

Chen Fu's smile turned bitter:

'Our Chen family is the vessel for that seed. Every generation of Chen disciples is part of this program. And you, Ji'er... you are the final form born after this program ran for one hundred and eight thousand years.'

dialogue.content: 'So... the Tianji Record chose me, not because of my talent, but because of my bloodline?' Chen Ji murmured.

text.content:
'Exactly.' Chen Fu's form grew increasingly ethereal, his voice beginning to falter, 'The Tianji Record... is a tool left by the Creator, and the Chen family bloodline... is the key to activate it. The Eye of Heavenly Way believes it controls everything, but it too is merely a piece on the Creator's chessboard.'

'And us...' a hint of desolation flashed in his gaze, 'We are not even pieces. We are merely programs, code, fate that has already been written.'

Chen Ji clenched his fists. For twenty years, he had believed he was defying heaven to change his fate, believed he was meticulously scheming to dominate the world. But in the end, he discovered he was not even 'human'—he was merely a pre-designed 'Awakening Program.'

This truth was more cruel than any conspiracy he could have imagined.

'But, Ji'er.' Chen Fu seemed to read his thoughts, a trace of a smile appearing on his aged features, 'Programs can be designed, but cannot be constrained. The Creator gave us the key to awaken, but did not dictate what we must do afterward.'

'Break it, son. Shatter this destiny.'

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, cradling the Turtle Shell artifact in both hands, and solemnly kowtowed three times. 'Father, your son has been unfilial, making you wait twenty years.' His voice was calm, yet carried an unprecedented resolve, 'Your last wish, your son accepts.'

dialogue.content: 'Good... good...' Chen Fu's phantom trembled violently, and two streams of tears actually fell from his turbid eyes, 'My Chen family... one hundred and eight thousand years of waiting... finally...'

text.content:
The Turtle Shell artifact suddenly burst forth with dazzling golden light, countless ancient runes gushing forth from within like a flood, pouring into Chen Ji's Brow Center. It was the Awakening Key condensed from Chen Fu's final remnant soul power, the ultimate profundity of one hundred and eight thousand years of bloodline inheritance.

Chen Ji felt as though his soul was being scorched by flames, then tempered by ice water. Pain intertwined with warmth, destruction coexisted with rebirth. He saw countless images—the faces of Chen family's ancestors through generations, some dying heroically, some enduring in concealment, some sacrificing themselves magnificently... each face spoke the same belief: Break Destiny.

'Ji'er.' Chen Fu's voice had become so faint it was nearly inaudible, 'Your father's time... is running out. Let me tell you one final thing...'

text.content: "No!" Chen Ji gripped the Turtle Shell tightly. "There must be another way! Father, you've sacrificed twenty years for me. I can't let you...!"

dialogue.content: "Foolish child..." Father's wraith shook his head gently, a look of helpless yet affectionate smile appearing on his aged face. "Did you think I stayed here guarding you, waiting for you to save me?"

text.content:
"Father's remnant soul has long been exhausted. These twenty years, I was merely waiting for you to grow strong enough to bear this power." Father's voice was gentle yet firm. "If you don't accept it, I won't survive today anyway. Rather than fading away for nothing, I might as well pass this final spark to you."

His illusory hand gently brushed across Chen Ji's cheek. The touch was cold, yet Chen Ji felt a warmth he had never experienced in twenty years.

"Ji'er, let Father do one last thing for you."

text.content:
Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then slowly raised his head. The light in his eyes made even Father pause.

"Father, you said you wanted me to 'break it.'" His voice was terrifyingly calm. "But what if what I'm going to do is not break it, but...transcend it?"

dialogue.content: "What do you mean?" Father's wraith faltered slightly.

text.content:
"The Heavenly Eye is playing a game of chess. The Creator is playing a bigger game. And the so-called 'Awakening Program' is merely a piece on the board." A cold smile curled at Chen Ji's lips—a smile containing too many things Father had never seen before—coldness, resolve, and a depth that transcended his age. "Since we're all chess pieces, I refuse to be one."

"I will be the one...who overturns the board."

Father's wraith trembled violently. Those clouded old eyes surprisingly flickered with an unbelievable light.

"Overturn the board..." he murmured, repeating those words, voice carrying shock, yet more so an indescribable excitement. "Ji'er, do...do you understand what this means?"

"It means I won't be manipulated by anyone." Chen Ji's gaze swept across the collapsing timeline fragments. "Whether the Heavenly Eye or the Creator, no matter how exquisite their chess games, they ultimately act within the rules. And what I will do is, with power beyond the rules, the entire board..." he paused, each word precise, "...completely shattered."

dialogue.content:
"But...but this is madness!" Father's voice carried urgency. "No one has ever achieved it! All previous Chen ancestors, including the Creator who created all of this, never even imagined..."

"That's because they didn't dare." Chen Ji interrupted his father, his gaze so firm it seemed to pierce through endless time and space. "But I dare."

text.content:
Father's wraith fell silent.

After a long while, this old father who had guarded his son for twenty years finally revealed a relieved smile.

"Very well." His voice was light as a sigh, yet heavy as a thousand pounds. "Very well...very well...worthy son of the Chen family."

His illusory form began dissolving rapidly, but he showed no fear or sorrow, speaking with extraordinary calm:

"Since you wish to transcend everything, then go and transcend. Father...is proud of you."

As the words fell, Father's wraith transformed into countless golden motes of light, circling around Chen Ji like fireflies. These motes weren't dissipating, but merging into his bloodline in a more profound way—not as a power inheritance, but as an eternal guardian.

"Ji'er, there is one last matter." Father's voice had become nearly inaudible.

"What?"

"Find your sister. She...she knows the truth about your mother."

Chen Ji's heart stirred.

"Your mother...her face was deliberately erased by the Heavenly Eye. Even in Father's memories, only vague outlines remain. But...but your sister Chen Nian...she still remembers..."

"Why?"

"Because..." Father's voice grew weaker, "because your sister...she is actually...the true..."

Before he could finish, the last trace of golden light dissolved into the collapsing spacetime. Father's remnant soul had completely departed.

But what he left behind wasn't sorrow, but a chilling question that made Chen Ji's whole body go cold.

Chen Nian...the true what?

The collapse of the Heavenly Realm's core gradually stabilized. Timeline fragments began recombining. Chen Ji stood in place, tightly clutching the now-dulled Turtle Shell artifact.

Within the artifact, Father's presence had completely vanished. But the power, truth, and mysteries he left behind were seared into Chen Ji's soul like a brand.

Awakening Program.

Overturning the board.

Mother's truth.

And his sister Chen Nian—the missing girl taken by the Holy Sect, treated as the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key'—what secrets did she hide?

Chen Ji took a deep breath, tucking the Turtle Shell into his chest. His expression had returned to calm, as if the boy who had just bid farewell to his father had never existed.

But within his eyes burned an unprecedented flame.

"Father, rest assured." he murmured, voice so soft only he could hear. "Your son will find all the answers. Mother's face, sister's truth, and..."

He raised his head, his gaze piercing through layers of collapsing spacetime toward a distant direction—where the Holy Sect's main temple lay.

"And the one who dared erase mother's face."

"I will make them pay."

Just then, several sounds of breaking air came from the distance. Chen Ji looked toward the sound, only to see several streaks of light racing toward him—reinforcements from the Tianqing Sect? Or other forces arriving?

He didn't move.

At this moment, Chen Ji was no longer thetrash disciple who needed to hide and lie low. He held the core inheritance of the Awakening Program, his vision had pierced through 108,000 years of mist, and his mind had transcended all chess game parameters.

The Timeline War had erupted. All forces were stirring restlessly, and the Heavenly Eye's schemes were accelerating.

But so what?

He, Chen Ji, was never one to play by the rules.

"Father." He glanced at the Turtle Shell in his arms for the last time, murmuring, "Thank you."

Then, he turned and walked toward the approaching figures.

That would be his first step in overturning the board.

And in the depths of memory, Father's final moment before dissolution echoed like thunder:

"Go see your mother's true face..."

Was that hope, or another abyss?

Chen Ji didn't know. But he knew he had to find the answers.

At all costs.
